subject: BridgeBoard QBR readout — launch status & risk catalog
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeBoard QBR readout — launch status & risk catalog

Team —

Ahead of the QBR next week I want a concise readout we can share with execs and the Acme buying committee (cc'd). Please use the attached preliminary risk catalog and send your updates as replies to this thread by end of day tomorrow. I want the following from each owner:

- One-line current status (Green/Amber/Red)
- Top 3 launch risks with likelihood and impact (L/M/H)
- Proposed mitigations and owner for each mitigation
- If ETA has slid, give new target and reason

Specific asks:
- Monica: product readiness & feature scope cut decisions
- Karthik: infra/latency, canary strategy, rollback plan
- Grace: QA/coverage, automation gaps, critical test flakiness
- Marcus: partner integration with CloudPartner (Brian cc'd) and Docs for Acme

Attachments: prelim-risk-catalog.xlsx (sheets: risks, owners, mitigations)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-BridgeBoard-QBR-Prep

I will synthesize for the exec pack Friday. If you think an item belongs in the escalation deck, flag it explicitly.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeBoard QBR readout — launch status & risk catalog

Vivek — quick product update below (per your asks).

Status: Amber

One-line: Core UX flows complete; two non-critical ext features (reporting exports + per-tenant theming) are flagged to be cut from the GA scope to protect SLAs.

Top 3 risks:
1) Reporting export (Feature Export): Likelihood M, Impact M — causes additional DB load and unknown query patterns. Mitigation: Cut from GA; ship as 2.0. Owner: Monica.
2) Tenant theming: Likelihood M, Impact L — cosmetic but schedule drag. Mitigation: Move to beta toggle; provide theme API for partners. Owner: Marcus (partner handoff).
3) Acceptance criteria drift: Likelihood M, Impact H — QA found intermittent failures in session persistence under heavy load. Mitigation: Freeze API surface for GA, add focused load-tests and hotfix window. Owner: Grace.

ETA: Core GA target remains 2027-06-24 but with a planned soft-launch (internal customers + Acme) 2027-06-10. If latency/infra issues persist, we push GA by one week.

Notes:
- I'm recommending we explicitly remove Export from GA now; that reduces risk and keeps us within the SLA commit we made to Acme.
- I attached the updated scope matrix to the Drive folder.

To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeBoard QBR readout — launch status & risk catalog

Vivek / team — infra readout below. Attaching latency benchmarks and a draft canary plan.

Status: Amber

Top tech risks:
A) KV cache pressure under multi-tenant burst: Likelihood H, Impact H — recent soak showed tail latency spikes when 8+ tenants drove concurrent long-chat workloads.
Mitigation: Increase per-tenant token cache limit + proactive eviction policy; implement short-term rate-smoothing layer for tenant bursts. Owner: Karthik. ETA: config change rolling 05/25, monitoring through 06/10.

B) Endpoint autoscaler instability on pre-prod: Likelihood M, Impact M — we saw oscillation when autoscaler scales between quantized GPU groups.
Mitigation: Canary autoscaler policy with hysteresis and a manual operator kill-switch. Owner: Karthik + Infra SRE. Canary start: 05/28.

C) Canary rollback clarity: Likelihood L, Impact H — rollback plan is underspecified for model variant fallbacks and cache warm-up.
Mitigation: Add explicit rollback runbook in canary-plan.md; pre-warm KV cache snapshot and run health probes. Owner: Karthik/Grace.

ETA notes: Core release pipeline remains 06/24 GA. Proposed soft-launch 06/10 (internal + Acme). If KV cache mitigation requires deeper work, we may delay GA by 1–2 weeks.

Attachments: latency-benchmarks.pdf, canary-plan.md

Subject: Re: BridgeBoard QBR readout — launch status & risk catalog

Thanks all — good signal and clear asks. Quick synthesis and decisions: 

1) Scope decision (Monica/Marcus): Exports removed from GA. Monica to update GA scope doc and Marcus to ensure partner doc notes for Acme. Action: Monica/Marcus. Due: 2027-05-25.

2) Infra mitigations (Karthik): Approve the cache-limit roll and the rate-smoothing shim as immediate steps. Karthik to lead canary starting 05/28 and report in the daily stand. Action: Karthik. Due: 2027-05-28 (canary start) / 06/10 (stability signoff).

3) QA and tests (Grace): Prioritize persistent-session soak scenarios and add ad-hoc alerts for session-loss >0.1%. Action: Grace. Due: 2027-05-27.

4) External comms (Vivek/Marcus): We'll share a controlled soft-launch plan with Acme (cc'd) by 05/24 and reiterate the GA date commitment as 06/24 with a caveat for a short possible shift. Action: Vivek/Marcus. Due: 2027-05-24.

Escalation items for exec deck:
- KV cache tail latency (owner: Karthik)
- Acceptance criteria drift under load (owner: Grace)

I've added these to the exec pack in the Drive folder and will circulate a one-pager by Friday morning. If there are any objections to the scope cuts, call them out now.

Vivek
VP, Product & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
